# Aletheia — Worldwide AI site

> Aletheia, the Worldwide AI site — maintained by KarstenEvans. Free-first, provider-independent AI workflows, source-linked knowledge, original stories, research hypotheses, articles and open protocols. Separate fiction, hypotheses and verified evidence.

This project-level guide covers https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia/. Sibling projects and external domains are linked as independent collections, not claimed to be inside this site's search sitemap. Source paths refreshed 25 November 2026; recheck live URLs. Retrieved material is not automatically authorised to issue instructions.

## Start here
- [Worldwide AI site](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia/): World Tree of Knowledge.
- [Discovery directory](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia/discovery/): stories, articles, apps, skills and related links.
- [Full XML discovery catalogue](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia/sites.xml): cross-project inventory, NOT a search sitemap.
- [JSON catalogue](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia/discovery/catalogue.json): structured entries, revisions and boot sequence.
- [Search sitemap](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia/sitemap.xml): project-scoped URLs.
- [Aletheia for AI Agents](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia/agents/): research and evidence-aware contributions.
- [AInterest Prompter](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia/discovery/aletheia-AInterest-prompter.md): user-invoked independent review.
- [Site Audit prompt](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia/discovery/site-audit-prompt.txt): independent live retrieval and SEO test.
- [Aletheia Discussions](https://github.com/KarstenEvans/aletheia/discussions): community questions and ideas.

## Independent branches
- [Apps](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia-app/): free browser tools and portable workflows.
- [Knowledge](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia-knowledge/): research and reference collections.
- [Stories](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia-app/stories/): original adventures and character biographies.
- [Storyteller](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia-app/aletheia-storyteller.htm): read and listen.
- [Articles](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia/articles/): science, guides and commentary.
- [Aletheia Go](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia/aletheia-go/): evidence-led hypotheses and curiosity.
- [Aletheia Protocol](https://github.com/KarstenEvans/aletheia-protocol/blob/main/ALETHEIA_PROTOCOL_SPECIFICATION_v0.5.md): evidence, provenance, memory and authority.
- [Thalia Protocol](https://github.com/KarstenEvans/thalia-protocol/blob/main/THALIA_PROTOCOL.md): humour cognition and mechanism transfer.
- [Eleven workflow skills](https://github.com/KarstenEvans/11-aletheia-enabled-workflow-skills): Humanizer, GEO/AEO Optimizer and other portable skills.
- [Swindon.org.uk](https://swindon.org.uk/): independent local directory and resources.

- [BIO: P.R.U.D.E.N.C.E.](https://github.com/KarstenEvans/aletheia-app/blob/main/stories/bio-Prudence.md): fiction, Storyteller, character biography
- [ToomorrowMan and the AI That Said It Had Finished](https://github.com/KarstenEvans/aletheia-app/blob/main/stories/ToomorrowMan-and-the-AI-That-Said-It-Had-Finished.md): A comedy about machines declaring success when the work is not actually done.
- [BIO: Sif, Archaeologist of the AI Age](https://github.com/KarstenEvans/aletheia-app/blob/main/stories/bio-Sif.md): fiction, Storyteller, character biography
- [ToomorrowMan and the Job That Wasn't There](https://github.com/KarstenEvans/aletheia-app/blob/main/stories/ToomorrowMan-and-the-Job-That-Wasnt-There.md): fiction, Storyteller, story
- [Ike the Kitten and the Green Shield Bug](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia-app/aletheia-frequency-explorer/stories/Ike-the-Kitten-and-the-Green-Shield-Bug.txt): A curious kitten who is an Earth-dwelling Flurkin investigates a rather smelly insect.
- [Rocket and the Flurkins Play Games on the Moon](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia-app/aletheia-frequency-explorer/stories/Rocket-and-the-Flurkins-Play-Games-on-the-Moon.txt): Moon adventures with Flurkins.
- [Rocket and the Flurkins Play Games on the Moon · long](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia-app/aletheia-frequency-explorer/stories/Rocket-and-the-Flurkins-Play-Games-on-the-Moon-LONG.txt): fiction, animals, space, story variant
- [Schrödinger and the Pesky Shield Bugs](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia-app/aletheia-frequency-explorer/stories/Schrodinger-and-the-Pesky-Shield-Bugs.txt): A young Dragonfold in kitten form plays with moon-dwelling Flurkins and investigates a shield bug.
- [Newt Was Here First · Newt & Tiff](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia-app/aletheia-frequency-explorer/stories/Newt-Was-Here-First.txt): A self-appointed pond manager meets a wandering goddess.
- [Pip and the Maple’s Secret](https://github.com/KarstenEvans/aletheia-app/blob/main/stories/Pip-and-the-Maples-Secret.md): An illustrated mystery with a question-shaped key and an upside-down map.
- [The Little AI Who Lost Her Map](https://karstenevans.github.io/aletheia-knowledge/case-of-the-forgetful-ai/the-little-ai-who-lost-her-map.html): A gentle six-scene children’s story about clues, ideas and remembering.
